t: This is a $(l:programming/conditions)Condition/$ widget.$(p)The $(thing)Condition: Fluid/$ widget allows you to (remotely) check tank(s) or fluid block(s) in the connected $(l:programming/area)Area/$ widget for a certain amount of fluid. It will only count the fluid allowed by a connected $(l:programming/liquid_filter)Fluid Filter/$ widget (omit the filter to allow every fluid).
这是一个$(l:programming/conditions)条件/$组件。$(p)$(thing)条件：流体/$组件可让你（远程）检查已连接的$(l:programming/area)区域/$组件中的储罐或流体方块内是否含有一定数量的流体。它只会统计已连接的$(l:programming/liquid_filter)流体过滤器/$组件所允许的流体（省略过滤器则允许任何流体）。
